centre.address: 5316 Rice Lake Scenic Dr, Gores Landing, ON K0K 2E0, Canada

about_blocks.text: Victoria Wellness focuses on addiction and mental wellness with a wide range of treatment tools. This includes both 12-Step and other non-12-Step modalities. They also use holistic and non-traditional methods like neurofeedback, ketamine assisted treatment, and dolphin neurostim. Every client’s treatment plan is tailored to their individual needs. This includes input from Victoria Wellness’ clinical staff as well as clients’ past experiences with trauma, addiction or mental illness. Clients receive the best, most comprehensive care, which ultimately leads to lasting recovery.

about_blocks.text: Amazing Staff, Designed To Lasting Recovery
about_blocks.html: Amazing Staff, Designed To Lasting Recovery

about_blocks.text: Victoria Wellness Residential Mental Health Center has highly qualified staff. Their psychologist and psychiatrist are professional and compassionate. They ensure that every client’s needs are met. There are several masters-level psychotherapists on staff, as well as a social worker and addiction counsellor, two mental health nurses, and a list of recovery coaches. Victoria Wellness Centre has a staff that is available to assist clients in their recovery and provides a complete service. A registered therapist runs all psychotherapy sessions such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, DBT and Dialectical Behaviour Therapy. Individual sessions at Victoria Wellness are conducted by a psychotherapist who acts as the primary therapist for clients throughout their treatment.

about_blocks.text: Recovery Skills and Habits: Building Habits
about_blocks.html: Recovery Skills and Habits: Building Habits

about_blocks.text: Victoria Wellness is focused on helping clients manage mental health issues well into the future. They prioritize physical activity in the afternoons as one of their habits and skills. They enjoy kayaking, hiking and playing tennis, as well as time at the gym, basketball and volleyball. Victoria Wellness offers evening sessions that build on morning treatments. Clients can also enjoy healthy meals that are tailored to their dietary restrictions and needs throughout their stay at Victoria Wellness.

Sober Fun and Restorative Amenities

about_blocks.text: The Victoria Wellness Centre places a high value on having fun both onsite and offsite. Clients will have access to a tranquil pool, a labyrinth and Reiki sessions. They can also fish and boat, or paddle board. Victoria Wellness offers a variety of fun and relaxing activities for clients. Clients can also take trips off-site to nearby farms, ski mountains, hiking trails and golf courses. Their fun activities promote the idea that sobriety can be enjoyable, more than the short-term pleasures that addictive substances offer.

about_blocks.text: Victoria Wellness offers personalized mental health treatment programs for Anxiety, Depression, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder, Sexual Assault, Addictions and more. Our treatment combines evidence-based therapy in a restorative setting–providing coping skills to clients so they can lead productive and successful lives. We have an excellent year-long aftercare program, as well as, a family therapy component during care and aftercare.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Victoria Wellness

faqs.question: Is Victoria Wellness accredited and licensed?

answer_blocks.text: Yes, Victoria Wellness is fully licensed and accredited by the Ontario Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care.
answer_blocks.html: Yes, Victoria Wellness is fully licensed and accredited by the Ontario Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care.

faqs.question: Does Victoria Wellness provide individualized treatment plans?

answer_blocks.text: Yes, each client receives an individualized treatment plan tailored to their unique needs and goals.
answer_blocks.html: Yes, each client receives an individualized treatment plan tailored to their unique needs and goals.

faqs.question: What types of therapies are included in the addiction treatment programs at Victoria Wellness?

answer_blocks.text: The addiction treatment programs at Victoria Wellness incorporate a range of evidence-based therapies, including cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavior therapy, trauma-focused therapy, and mindfulness-based therapy.
answer_blocks.html: The addiction treatment programs at Victoria Wellness incorporate a range of evidence-based therapies, including cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavior therapy, trauma-focused therapy, and mindfulness-based therapy.

faqs.question: What sets Victoria Wellness apart from other rehab centers?

answer_blocks.text: Victoria Wellness is known for its holistic approach to addiction treatment, incorporating not only evidence-based therapies, but also meditation, yoga, and physical fitness into its programs. In addition, Victoria Wellness offers a supportive and compassionate environment where clients can feel safe and supported throughout their recovery journey.

faqs.question: What amenities are available at Victoria Wellness rehab center?

answer_blocks.text: Victoria Wellness offers air-conditioned rooms, bathroom essentials, fitness center, gardens, housekeeping, outdoor space, private/shared rooms, recreation room, TV, theater, view, and walking trails.

faqs.question: What aftercare programs are available at Victoria Wellness rehab center?

answer_blocks.text: Victoria Wellness offers an excellent year-long aftercare program, family follow-up counseling, recovery coach, and support meetings.
